sections.label: Video
sections.info: Configure display cropping, frame skipping and other image output parameters.

items.label: Color Palette
items.info: Composite tries to recreate the original console output and can show more details in some games.

items.label: Frameskip
items.info: Skip frames to avoid audio buffer under-run (crackling). Improves performance at the expense of visual smoothness. 'Auto' skips frames when advised by the frontend. 'Manual' utilizes the 'Frameskip Threshold (%)' setting.

items.label: Frameskip Threshold (%)
items.info: When 'Frameskip' is set to 'Manual', specifies the audio buffer occupancy threshold (percentage) below which frames will be skipped. Higher values reduce the risk of crackling by causing frames to be dropped more frequently.

items.label: Horizontal Overscan (352 Width Mode Only)
items.info: Choose the maximum image width to be displayed. Lower values will crop the right side of the image (for 352 px width games).

items.label: Initial Scanline
items.info: First rendered scanline. Higher values will crop the top of the image.

items.label: Last Scanline
items.info: Last rendered scanline. Lower values will crop the bottom of the image.

sections.label: Input
sections.info: Configure light gun, mouse and NegCon input.

items.label: Mouse Sensitivity
items.info: Higher values will make the mouse cursor move faster.

items.label: Disable Soft Reset (RUN+SELECT)
items.info: When RUN and SELECT are pressed simultaneously, disable both buttons temporarily instead of resetting.

items.label: P1 Default Joypad Type
items.info: Choose if port 1 joypad should be 2 or 6 buttons by default. This option is only applied when the core starts, if you want to switch while content is running, use the 'Mode Switch' button. NOTE: 6 buttons joypad can have weird behaviors in non compatible games.

items.label: P2 Default Joypad Type
items.info: Choose if port 2 joypad should be 2 or 6 buttons by default. This option is only applied when the core starts, if you want to switch while content is running, use the 'Mode Switch' button. NOTE: 6 buttons joypad can have weird behaviors in non compatible games.

items.label: P3 Default Joypad Type
items.info: Choose if port 3 joypad should be 2 or 6 buttons by default. This option is only applied when the core starts, if you want to switch while content is running, use the 'Mode Switch' button. NOTE: 6 buttons joypad can have weird behaviors in non compatible games.

items.label: P4 Default Joypad Type
items.info: Choose if port 4 joypad should be 2 or 6 buttons by default. This option is only applied when the core starts, if you want to switch while content is running, use the 'Mode Switch' button. NOTE: 6 buttons joypad can have weird behaviors in non compatible games.

items.label: P5 Default Joypad Type
items.info: Choose if port 5 joypad should be 2 or 6 buttons by default. This option is only applied when the core starts, if you want to switch while content is running, use the 'Mode Switch' button. NOTE: 6 buttons joypad can have weird behaviors in non compatible games.

items.label: Turbo Toggle
items.info: Enable the turbo toggle hotkeys (buttons III and IV).

items.label: Alternate Turbo Hotkey
items.info: Assign RetroPad's L3/R3 buttons as turbo toggle hotkeys instead of buttons III and IV. Works only as long as nothing is assigned to the L3/R3 buttons. You can avoid remapping buttons III and IV when switching to 6-button controller mode with this.

items.label: Turbo Delay
items.info: Adjust the time between turbo fire (in frames).

sections.label: Emulation Hacks
sections.info: Configure processor overclocking and emulation accuracy parameters affecting low-level performance and compatibility.

items.label: No Sprite Limit
items.info: Remove 16-sprites-per-scanline hardware limit. WARNING: May cause graphics glitching on some games.

items.label: CPU Overclock Multiplier (Restart Required)
items.info: Higher values can reduce slowdowns in games. WARNING: Can cause glitches and crashes.

sections.label: Advanced Channel Volume Settings
sections.info: Configure the volume of individual hardware audio channels.

items.label: PSG Sound Channel 0 Volume %
items.info: Modify the volume of PSG Sound Channel 0.

items.label: PSG Sound Channel 1 Volume %
items.info: Modify the volume of PSG Sound Channel 1.

items.label: PSG Sound Channel 2 Volume %
items.info: Modify the volume of PSG Sound Channel 2.

items.label: PSG Sound Channel 3 Volume %
items.info: Modify the volume of PSG Sound Channel 3.

items.label: PSG Sound Channel 4 Volume %
items.info: Modify the volume of PSG Sound Channel 4.

items.label: PSG Sound Channel 5 Volume %
items.info: Modify the volume of PSG Sound Channel 5.

sections.label: PC Engine CD
sections.info: Configure settings related to the PC Engine CD emulation.

items.label: CD Image Cache (Restart Required)
items.info: Load the complete image into memory at startup. Can potentially decrease loading times at the cost of an increased startup time.

items.label: CD BIOS (Restart Required)
items.info: Most games can run on 'System Card 3'. 'Games Express' is needed for several unlicensed games.

items.label: (CD) CD Speed
items.info: Higher values enable faster loading times but can cause issues with a couple of games.

items.label: (CD) ADPCM Volume %
items.info: CD game only. Setting this volume control too high may cause sample clipping.

items.label: (CD) CDDA Volume %
items.info: CD game only. Setting this volume control too high may cause sample clipping.

items.label: (CD) PSG Volume %
items.info: CD game only. Setting this volume control too high may cause sample clipping.
